name: Vejer de la Frontera (Spain)
description: Olive green field charged at the centre with the arms of Vejer de la Frontera (a castle on red within an inscribed yellow bordure, in an ornate frame).
history: Municipal flag of Vejer de la Frontera; Spanish municipal flags are approved by the municipal council and the autonomous community and published in the regional official gazette.

features.role: Vejer de la Frontera arms — castle on red within an inscribed bordure
